justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No rehabilitation outcome data; value is emergency preparedness not functional improvement.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-day first responder course; low cost; widely available; quick to obtain.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable specifically in sideline sports coverage and event medical response; not relevant in clinical settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Enables sports venue coverage contracts; sideline work is fee-for-service or contract-based; not standard insurance billing.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Required for most sideline coverage positions in sports medicine and athletic training contexts.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Athlete confidence in sideline coverage is meaningful but not a clinical outcome.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Consumers don't pay PTs for emergency response skills; not a billable or marketable service.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: No pricing power; it's a safety credential, not a revenue driver.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Common safety cert; offers zero brand differentiation in private practice.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Doesn't generate services others can deliver; purely a compliance/safety layer.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients don't seek out PTs for EMR credentials.
justifications.business.efficiency: Short and cheap to obtain, so the small value it does provide comes at low cost.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Not a faculty credential; doesn't appear on promotion files in any meaningful way.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: No scholarly footprint associated with holders.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for clinical-site safety roles, sports residency oversight, or on-field coverage instruction.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying BLS/first-aid protocols are evidence-based but the cert itself isn't a research domain.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally required for faculty supervising sports/athletic settings but not broadly demanded.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap, fast, and easy to renew; efficient for the narrow value it provides.
